unknown_numeric_policy: A zero in a schema-required connector, snap, wall-hardware allowance, lead-in, minimum-wall or minimum-ligament field accompanied by dimensions_status is an explicit UNSELECTED sentinel, not an authorized CAD dimension. Parametric source generation shall fail closed until a calculation or named evidence replaces it.

requirements.statement: Each unique 600 x 400 mm pilot shall be manufactured as two permanent 300 x 400 mm main halves with one vertical seam and no rear grid.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: global bounds, Kobra 3 Max bed-fit report, component audit and assembled flatness test

requirements.statement: Each pilot shall preserve one immutable 16-bit global height master, physical aspect ratio and one elevation-to-model-Z transform; halves shall never be normalized independently.
requirements.verification: source manifest, aspect/scale report, center-seam height comparison and 16-bit master hash

requirements.statement: The family shall produce separate permanent one-off Harz and Rheinisches Braunkohlerevier pilots from frozen official elevation acquisitions.
requirements.source: user brief and approved design specification 0.3.0
requirements.verification: pilot-specific source manifests, extents, previews and rebuild jobs

requirements.statement: Each continuous terrain surface shall use four broad abstract altitude colors through exactly three global layer changes, without dithering or realistic land-cover claims.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: global threshold report, 3MF validation and exact-slicer tool/change/purge report

requirements.statement: Exactly three concealed loose printed one-way spring/tenon connectors and discrete locating lands shall join each pilot without glue, magnets, screws or a replaceable service interface.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and user correction
requirements.verification: interface ownership audit, strain calculation, shared process-matched coupon and one-time assembly test per pilot

requirements.statement: Each pilot shall use two upper local hanger parts and two lower local standoffs snapped into isolated rear sockets to create an 18 mm wall gap without a rear frame.
requirements.source: approved isolated snap-in hanger/standoff architecture; count recommended in decomposition 0.3.0
requirements.verification: proxy load-path review, same-process snap coupon, wall-plane gauge and mass-based proof test

requirements.statement: Each unlit pilot shall remain complete while reserving optional customer lighting envelopes for an indirect halo and selected true front-through terrain paths.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: keep-out collision audit, aperture report, lighting gauge and human lit/unlit appearance review

requirements.statement: LEDs, wiring, power supply, controller, diffuser, wall hardware and electrical work are excluded; the terrain is decorative and makes no survey, mining-safety, navigation or universal wall-load claim.
requirements.verification: BOM, data disclaimer, installation boundary and release-package review

global_style.summary: Abstract gallery-like continuous terrain with broad four-band palettes, one controlled seam and sparse luminous terrain traces
global_style.generation_material: four same-family matte PLA colors on a flat-backed printed substrate
global_style.detail_hierarchy: whole-region relief first, seam-locked major landforms second, broad altitude breaks third, printable local terrain last

physical: four main halves across two pilots
appearance: sparse illuminated valleys or mine traces
manufacturing: two 300 x 400 flat prints per pilot

assembly_sequence: Freeze and hash the official source acquisition for the selected pilot, create one 16-bit global master and approve its extent/vertical interpretation.
Print the shared off-product connector and standoff coupon with the exact production printer, nozzle, material, orientation and profile.
Select and record the passing pocket compensation and flexure candidate; regenerate all mating bodies from the shared interface kit.
Insert three selected one-way connectors into the left main half, align both halves on a flat fixture and press the right half home once.
Snap two upper hanger parts and two lower standoffs into the isolated rear sockets and verify the 18 mm wall plane.
Optionally add customer lighting only inside the declared rear lands, strip keep-outs and cable routes, then install with substrate-appropriate wall hardware.

decision_log.topic: Approve the revision 0.3.0 component, interface, manufacturing and coupon decomposition for both pilots.
decision_log.current_basis: Requirements and concept v02 are approved; the guided autonomy policy assigns decomposition approval to Stefan.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Explicit approval of plan/hybrid-design-plan-v0.3.0.json or requested corrections.

decision_log.topic: Freeze shared connector spring dimensions, root radius, allowed strain, pocket compensation and one-time retention behavior.
decision_log.current_basis: Topology, quantity per pilot and 0.15/0.25/0.35/0.45 mm per-side process-coupon series are approved; no physical result exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Material-specific strain calculation followed by the shared same-process coupon and a representative seam test.

decision_log.topic: Freeze shared local hanger/standoff snap geometry and pilot-specific installed proof-load acceptance.
decision_log.current_basis: Two upper load points plus two lower plane-setting points per pilot are the minimal balanced candidate; no wall substrate or physical snap evidence exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Same-process snap coupon, each completed artwork mass, actual wall substrate/hardware and installer-owned proof-test plan.

decision_log.topic: Freeze Copernicus GLO-30 source tiles, extent, vertical reference, licence evidence and hashes for Harz.
decision_log.current_basis: Copernicus GLO-30 is the approved cross-state official-data route and the target crop contains the Harz massif and Brocken.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable local DEM set, acquisition manifest, CRS/vertical reference, hashes and attribution notice.

decision_log.topic: Freeze current GeoBasis NRW DGM1 tiles, extent, acquisition state, licence evidence and hashes for the Rhenish pilot.
decision_log.current_basis: Current DGM1 is preferred because open-cast terrain changes materially; the target crop covers Garzweiler, Hambach and Inden.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable local DGM1 set, acquisition state, CRS/vertical reference, hashes and reviewed Data Licence Germany attribution.

decision_log.topic: Freeze each pilot's vertical exaggeration and three global color-change heights.
decision_log.current_basis: Relief depth is capped at 7 mm; continuous 16-bit geometry and broad global bands are approved, but source distributions are not yet available.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Global elevation distributions, scale/threshold report, relief previews and human appearance review.

decision_log.topic: Freeze each pilot's selected light-through path set.
decision_log.current_basis: Concept v02 approves sparse Harz valley/contour and Rhenish mine-bench/infrastructure paths; final geometry depends on the frozen masters.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Pilot-specific aperture previews, minimum-width/ligament reports and physical light-envelope coupon.

decision_log.topic: Freeze physical Harz and Rhenish palette spools and transition purge matrices.
decision_log.current_basis: Both abstract palettes are approved; supplier products, batches, measured swatches and opacity are not recorded.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Spool/batch identities, swatches, opacity notes and exact-profile directed transition coupon.

decision_log.topic: Select wall-substrate-specific anchors outside each product package.
decision_log.current_basis: The products provide local hanger geometry only; wall substrate and fasteners are customer/installer-specific.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Actual wall substrate, chosen hardware data and installed proof test by the responsible installer for each pilot.
